title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past

retroarch.note: Super Nintendo cores (Snes9x, Mesen-S...): the 128 KB of WRAM from $7E0000, address 0 of READ_CORE_RAM, bytes in order. Names of No-Intro and GoodSNES: Legend of Zelda, The - A Link to the Past (USA), (Europe), (France), (Germany), (Canada) (Fr), Zelda no Densetsu - Kamigami no Triforce (Japan) and its revisions. The addresses come from the USA version; the other versions are matched too.

module.note: main_module_index ($10): 00 intro, 01 file select, 07 dungeon, 09 overworld, 0E menus and texts, 12 death, 13 and 16 boss victory, 14 attract, 19 triforce room, 1A credits (snesrev/zelda3 src/variables.h, misc.c kMainRouting)

submodule.note: submodule_index ($11), in the death module: 07 to 09 the GAME OVER letters, 0A to 0C the fairy (snesrev/zelda3 src/variables.h, messaging.c kModule_Death)

facing.note: link_direction_facing ($2F): 0 up, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right (snesrev/zelda3 src/variables.h)

action.note: link_player_handler_state ($5D): 02 recoil, 03 spin attack, 04 swimming, 08 Ether, 09 Bombos, 0A Quake, 11 dashing, 13 hookshot, 14 mirror, 15 holds an item up, 17 bunny, 1E spin attack (snesrev/zelda3 src/variables.h, player.c kPlayerHandlers)
